description: Create bitmap font definitions for 3x5, 5x7, and 7x9 canonical sizes in src/implementation-files/bitmapFonts.ts. Each glyph is a boolean 2D array. Supported characters: A-Z (uppercase), 0-9, common punctuation (. , ! ? - ' " : ; / ( ) & @ # + =), and space.
steps_to_verify: File exists at src/implementation-files/bitmapFonts.ts
All three font sizes (3x5, 5x7, 7x9) are defined
Each font size has glyph definitions for all 26 uppercase letters (A-Z)
Each font size has glyph definitions for digits 0-9
Each font size has glyph definitions for all specified punctuation: . , ! ? - ' " : ; / ( ) & @ # + =
Each font size has a space glyph (all-false array of appropriate width)
Glyph arrays match their canonical dimensions (e.g., 3x5 glyphs are 5 rows of 3 booleans)
All fonts are monospace: every character within a font size has the same width matching the canonical width (3, 5, or 7 columns)
Glyph dimension validation: a runtime assertion or TypeScript type constraint verifies each glyph array matches its font's canonical row/column counts
Glyphs produce recognizable characters when rendered as pixel grids

description: Implement font selection algorithm that maximizes actual rendered height without exceeding the target. For each font (7x9, 5x7, 3x5), compute scale = floor(targetHeight / fontHeight) and actualHeight = fontHeight * scale. Select the font+scale combo with the largest actualHeight. Tiebreak: prefer the higher-resolution (larger canonical) font.
steps_to_verify: Target height 5 selects 3x5 at 1x (actual: 5)
Target height 7 selects 5x7 at 1x (actual: 7)
Target height 8 selects 5x7 at 1x (actual: 7) — 5x7@1x=7 beats 3x5@1x=5
Target height 9 selects 7x9 at 1x (actual: 9)
Target height 10 selects 3x5 at 2x (actual: 10) — 3x5@2x=10 beats 7x9@1x=9
Target height 14 selects 5x7 at 2x (actual: 14) — 5x7@2x=14 beats 3x5@2x=10 and 7x9@1x=9
Target height 18 selects 7x9 at 2x (actual: 18)
Target height 27 selects 7x9 at 3x (actual: 27)
Target height < 5 returns null/error (minimum font 3x5 doesn't fit)
Integer scaling means each font pixel becomes a scale*scale block of cells

description: Create src/implementation-files/generateTextGrid.ts that converts text + config into a boolean[][] grid. Input: text string, character height, grid dimensions (cols x rows), alignment, vertical alignment, word wrap flag, invert flag. Output: boolean[][] of same shape as pattern grids.
steps_to_verify: File exists at src/implementation-files/generateTextGrid.ts
Function accepts text config and grid dimensions, returns boolean[][] grid plus validation metadata (unsupported characters list, total vs visible line counts) for use by VALID-1
Output grid has dimensions matching cols x rows
Text is converted to uppercase before rendering
Characters not in the font are skipped (with unsupported chars tracked for validation)
Single-line text is correctly placed on the grid
Empty text or all-space text produces an all-false grid (all-true when invert is enabled)

description: Implement text layout with scaled spacing: (1 * scale) cells gap between characters horizontally, (2 * scale) cells gap between lines vertically. Spacing scales with the font scale factor to maintain consistent visual proportions. Support real newline characters from textarea input.
steps_to_verify: At 1x scale: adjacent characters have exactly 1 cell of empty space between them
At 1x scale: adjacent text lines have exactly 2 cells of empty space between them
At 3x scale: adjacent characters have exactly 3 cells of empty space between them
At 3x scale: adjacent text lines have exactly 6 cells of empty space between them
Newline characters in text input (from textarea Enter key) create a new line
Multiple consecutive newlines create proportional vertical gaps
Newlines are encoded as %0A in URL params and \n in JSON export

description: Implement horizontal alignment (left, center, right) for text lines within the grid.
steps_to_verify: Left alignment: text starts at column 0 (or left edge)
Center alignment: text is horizontally centered in the grid
Right alignment: text ends at the right edge of the grid
Each line is independently aligned (e.g., a short line and a long line both center correctly)

description: Implement vertical alignment (top, center, bottom) for the entire text block within the grid.
steps_to_verify: Top alignment: first line starts at row 0 (or top edge)
Center alignment: text block is vertically centered in the grid
Bottom alignment: last line ends at the bottom edge of the grid
Vertical alignment works correctly with multi-line text

description: Implement optional word wrapping that breaks text at word boundaries to fit within grid width.
steps_to_verify: When word wrap is enabled, long lines wrap at word boundaries (spaces)
Wrapped lines respect horizontal alignment setting
Words that are wider than the grid width render as many characters as fit (truncated at character boundary, same as no-wrap behavior)
When word wrap is disabled, text that exceeds grid width is truncated at character boundaries (never mid-glyph)
Word wrap interacts correctly with explicit \n line breaks

description: Implement invert mode: when enabled, the grid is fully filled (all true) and text characters become 'holes' (false cells).
steps_to_verify: When invert is false, text cells are true and background cells are false (normal)
When invert is true, background cells are true and text cells are false (negative space)
Invert works correctly with all alignment and wrapping options

description: Add a 'stateType' concept to the type system. Each animation slot (from/to) and the single non-animated view can be either 'pattern' or 'text'. Add TextConfig type with fields: text (string), charHeight (number), alignment ('left'|'center'|'right'), verticalAlignment ('top'|'center'|'bottom'), wordWrap (boolean), invert (boolean).
steps_to_verify: StateType type exists: 'pattern' | 'text'
TextConfig interface is defined with all six fields
Types are exported and accessible to components and hooks

description: Extend useFragmentState to manage stateType and textConfig for both from and to states. When animation is disabled, manage a single stateType/textConfig. When animation is enabled, manage fromStateType/fromTextConfig and toStateType/toTextConfig independently.
steps_to_verify: State includes fromStateType (default: 'pattern') and toStateType (default: 'pattern')
State includes fromTextConfig and toTextConfig with sensible defaults
When animation is disabled, a single stateType/textConfig is used
Changing state type between 'pattern' and 'text' preserves the other type's config
TextConfig defaults: text='', charHeight=15, alignment='center', verticalAlignment='center', wordWrap=true, invert=false
When animation is disabled, the 'from' state becomes the single displayed state (consistent with existing params behavior). The 'to' config is preserved but hidden.
When animation is re-enabled, both states return with their previous configurations intact

description: Create a TextConfigPanel component in src/app/components/fragment/ with controls for: text input (textarea), character height (slider, 5-100), horizontal alignment (button group: Left/Center/Right), vertical alignment (button group: Top/Center/Bottom), word wrap (checkbox), invert (checkbox).
steps_to_verify: TextConfigPanel component renders all six controls

Horizontal alignment shows three options as a button group
Vertical alignment shows three options as a button group

Text input has a 500-character limit
Component styling matches existing panel style (ParametersPanel)

description: Add a state type selector (Pattern / Text toggle) above each parameter panel slot. When animation is disabled, show one selector above the single panel. When animation is enabled, show one selector above each of the From and To panels. Selecting 'Pattern' shows ParametersPanel; selecting 'Text' shows TextConfigPanel.
steps_to_verify: State type selector renders as a toggle/radio with 'Pattern' and 'Text' options
When animation is disabled: one selector is shown, controlling the single panel
When animation is enabled: two selectors shown, one for From and one for To
Selecting 'Pattern' renders the ParametersPanel for that slot
Selecting 'Text' renders the TextConfigPanel for that slot
Mixed states work: e.g., From=Text, To=Pattern shows TextConfigPanel on left and ParametersPanel on right

description: Modify SVG generation to support text grids as from/to states. When a state type is 'text', generate the boolean[][] grid via generateTextGrid instead of generateGrid. Pass the resulting grid into the existing diff SVG mechanism (data-g='a'/'b' attributes).
steps_to_verify: Pattern->Pattern: behavior unchanged from current implementation
Pattern->Text: pattern grid as 'from', text grid as 'to', diff SVG generated correctly

Text->Text: both grids from text, diff SVG generated correctly
Hover animation works for all four combinations (wave BFS reveal)

description: When animation is disabled and state type is 'text', generate a static SVG from the text grid using the existing gridToSvg function.

Canvas settings (dimensions, cell size, colors) are applied correctly
Invert mode works in static view
SVG can be exported (download and copy-to-clipboard)

description: Update import to handle v2.2.0 format. Gracefully handle missing state type fields (default to 'pattern'). Validate textConfig fields on import. Maintain full backward compatibility with v2.1.0 imports.

description: Add URL parameters for text state: fst/tst (state type), ftxt/ttxt (text content, URI-encoded), fch/tch (character height), fal/tal (alignment), fva/tva (vertical alignment), fww/tww (word wrap, 0/1), fin/tin (invert, 0/1). Only include when state type is 'text'.

description: Show real-time validation messages in the text config panel: (1) 'Text truncated: X of Y lines visible' when text overflows vertically, (2) 'Grid too small for this character size' when minimum font (3x5) doesn't fit at scale 1, (3) 'Unsupported characters: ...' for characters without glyph definitions.
